messages:
alex: Quick sync — Optimize toolkit delivery: we need clear owners for the remaining quantization recommendations PRs and batching/cache suggestions. Goal: QA signoff by Wed EOD, canary rollout Fri morning. Who's taking what?

maria: I can take the quant recs doc and surface any change notes for docs. Do we have the final perf targets?

kevin: PR ready for quant recs -> https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4823 needs 1 reviewer + LGTM. Perf numbers in PR description.

priya: Heads up: packaging of quantized weights depends on eng-infra node that bundles artifacts. I've pinged infra team but no ETA. tagging @ops-bot to confirm artifact pipeline status.

ops-bot: CI artifact pipeline: last bundle job succeeded 2h ago. Next scheduled packaging window 02:00 UTC. No blockers reported. :white_check_mark:

jamie: I can own the canary rollout. Need clarity on SLOs — we target p99 < 250ms for batched inference and <= $0.0009/token for cost estimate during canary. Are those the right numbers?

kevin: those numbers look right for small/med prompts. For long-context loads p99 might be ~350ms; we'll include fallback route to smaller KV cache for canary.

sasha: FYI ran quick canary tests on staging — hit a regression on one eval slice: Rouge drops ~4 points when using the new quant profile + batching enabled. Traces show tokenization edgecases + soffit for short prompts.

maria: can you paste the failing prompt id and sample output? we should add to regression alert set so CI blocks on it.

sasha: failing prompt IDs: [c-9921, c-9950]. Sample diff inline: 
```
expected: "The company announced..."
actual: "Company announced..." (lost article)
```
Small but triggers UX regressions in downstream rerankers.

kevin: thanks — looks like quantization trimmed a tiny part of embedding initializer. I'll open a hotfix branch to tighten quant thresholds and run local eval. PR WIP: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4831

priya: if hotfix needed, packaging queue might slip the Wednesday QA target by ~1 day. Recommend we parallelize docs + rollout playbook so we don't block.

jamie: agree. I'll draft the canary runbook now and start stakeholder ping list. If hotfix lands, we can gate canary on the patched image.

alex: Action items: 1) kevin owns hotfix + test (owner: kevin, ETA: 6h) 2) maria owns quant recs doc + regression set (owner: maria, ETA: EOD today) 3) priya follow infra packaging status (owner: priya) 4) jamie owns canary playbook and rollout (owner: jamie, ready by Thu AM). Marking QA signoff target -> Wed EOD contingent on hotfix.

maria: adding regression items to CI blocklist and pushing updated eval job. Will comment on PR 4823 once done.

kevin: starting hotfix now. Will run eval and post results here.

deploy-bot: CI status: PR 4831 build started. Tests: unit, integration, eval.

sasha: once kevin posts eval, I can re-run the staging slice and confirm. If green, we proceed to canary.

alex: thanks team. If anyone hits blockers, ping here and escalate to eng-platform leads. :thumbsup:

kevin: quick note — adding a small config tweak to batching window (default -> 8ms) might reduce p99 variance. I'll include as optional flag in PR.

jamie: noted. that flag should be toggleable via rollout config so we can flip during canary.

maria: done updating docs checklist. linking to this thread in the delivery issue. :white_check_mark:

kevin: evals done — rouge regressed by 0.2 after tightening thresholds. Posting results and diff to PR.

sasha: re-run on staging now, preliminary looks good. will run full slice and report by EOD.

alex: great progress. leaving this thread open for final QA signal.
